description: This file defines an Angular service named DeviceService responsible for managing device data. It interacts with an HTTP backend to fetch device lists and individual device info, supports grouping and refreshing devices, and contains utility methods for sorting and reactive data handling.

classes.name: DeviceService
classes.description: Angular service for device data management, including fetching, sorting, and reactive updates.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of device data from the server.

methods.name: setGroupId
methods.description: Sets the current device group ID for filtering displayed devices.

methods.name: getDevices
methods.description: Returns an observable stream of device data, filtered by group if applicable.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific device by ID.
